t: Ina Garten's Trick to Keeping Herbs Fresh for Longer Is Genius
s: August 26, 2025 - What I love about Garten’s advice is that she makes use of a kitchen product I already own, rather than recommending I buy something new. Now, in addition to rinsing berries, draining beans, and washing lettuce, I can use my salad spinner to wash delicate herbs without worrying about damaging them. Or, if you don’t already own a salad spinner, OXO makes a tiny version specifically designed for small amounts of salad and herbs. It works the same way, but takes up less room in your cabinets. No matter which model you choose, Ina Garten’s advice is worth following.
